structure: Four arm folders under one study folder: Human_Hilic_Pos, Human_Hilic_Neg, Human_Lipid_Pos, Human_Lipid_Neg; rows name <sample>_Hilic_<pol> or <sample>_Lip_<pol>, and each folder adds QC and blank files no row names. Human_Hilic_Neg and Human_Lipid_Neg hold byte-identical files (CRC32 and size).

evidence_sources.detail: Zip central directory listing read before download; CRC32 and size show the two negative folders identical.

groups.rationale: Hilic and Pos in folder and name, and no byte-identical twin.
Pooled QC in the HILIC positive folder.
Blank in the HILIC positive folder.
Lipid and Pos in folder and name: the reversed-phase lipid positive arm.
Pooled QC in the lipid positive folder.
Blank in the lipid positive folder.
Lipid and Neg in folder and name; its byte-identical twin sits in the HILIC negative folder, so a person settles which arm the content is.
Pooled QC in the lipid negative folder, byte-identical to the HILIC negative QC.
Blank in the lipid negative folder; it has no twin.

disposition.detail: Byte-identical (CRC32 and size) to the file of the same sample in the lipid negative folder; which arm the content is waits for a person.

groups.rationale: The HILIC negative folder repeats the lipid negative files byte for byte; the folder name does not settle the content.

disposition.detail: Byte-identical (CRC32 and size) to the lipid negative QC of the same number.

groups.rationale: A copy of a lipid negative QC under the HILIC negative folder.

disposition.detail: The blank of the HILIC negative folder, an arm this unit does not run.

groups.rationale: A blank whose arm has no sample data of its own in the deposit.

exceptions.rationale: Name drift: the row's file is listed with a double underscore and no separator before Pos; it is the only lipid positive member of that sample.

shared_flags.detail: Every sample and QC file of the HILIC negative folder is byte-identical to one in the lipid negative folder; the mzML sourceFile and the elution order after preflight settle which arm the content is.

AN003728.rationale: HILIC positive: the Human_Hilic_Pos rows with their QC and blank, none of them shared.

AN003729.rationale: Its folder holds copies of the lipid negative files, so the deposit may have no HILIC negative data; nothing is kept until a person decides.

exclude.detail: The only unique file of the HILIC negative folder; with no HILIC negative sample data it serves no run until a person decides.

needs_person.question: The HILIC negative files are byte-identical to the lipid negative files. Which arm is the content (mzML sourceFile, elution order)?

AN003730.rationale: Reversed-phase positive: the Human_Lipid_Pos rows with their QC and blank, one row through a name-drift exception.

AN003731.rationale: The lipid negative files are kept by folder, but a byte-identical copy sits under the HILIC negative folder; a person settles the content.

needs_person.question: These files are byte-identical to the HILIC negative folder's. Is the content reversed phase (mzML sourceFile, elution order)?
